allowed_claims: The external supplementary trace contains 114 rows (111 hypotheses and three baselines) in one research programme, and its supplied parser reproduces the CSV byte-for-byte from the Markdown log.
Three reported Phase-1→Phase-2 decisions form retrospective regime-applicability reversals; scoped revalidation is exact for those three while preserving original-scope records.
The observation strengthens the design requirement that every finding carry regime metadata and that applicability be rechecked on regime transition.
mandatory_limits: The three pairs are nested observations in one programme, not n=3 independent studies.
Dataset, parameter scale, augmentation family and evaluation protocol changed together; never attribute the reversals to scale alone.
Scoped 3/3 is a retrospective rule replay over selected observed reversals, not a prospective predictor or ARGO efficacy result.
Training code, tracking exports, failed-run configs and per-hypothesis source commits are absent; scores/code are not independently reproduced.
suggested_korean_claim: 외부 단일 연구 프로그램의 114개 기록에서는 세 훈련 결정이 복합 레짐 전환 뒤 반대 방향으로 재평가되었다. 범위가 지정된 재검증은 원래 범위의 결과를 보존하면서 세 적용가능성 판단을 모두 다시 열었지만, 이는 사후 선택된 세 사례의 기제 검증이며 독립 표본이나 전향적 효능 증거가 아니다.
